text: The authors find that reward-weighted voting clearly outperforms best-of-n reranking, and say this diverges from past research, including Lightman et al., where the two showed minimal differences. They attribute the discrepancy to their weaker base model (Llemma) on hard MATH problems, which may weaken the reward model and lead to reward over-optimization.
title: Sun et al. find weighted voting beats best-of-n, diverging from Lightman et al.'s small gap
